notes: Official Logitech data sheet (published July 2022, part numbers 952-000091 Graphite / 952-000094 White). Tap Scheduler is a 10.1" wall/glass/mullion-mounted room-scheduling touch panel, not a video source/switch — it has no HDMI, USB, or analog A/V ports. Its only physical I/O is a single RJ45 port carrying both 10/100 Mbps Ethernet data and PoE power (802.3af Type 1, Class 3); no separate power jack exists. WiFi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac and Bluetooth 5.0 are present but wireless (Bluetooth currently inactive, reserved for future use) so not listed as physical ports. Cross-checked against Logitech Hub support spec page and IPPhone Warehouse retailer listing, both consistent with the data sheet.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: 10/100 Mbps RJ45; also serves as the power input via PoE (IEEE 802.3af Type 1, Class 3) — device has no separate power connector. Requires a PoE-enabled network switch or PoE injector (not included).
